description: Every control-flow decision the methodology makes: one id, one program, one home. scripts/decide.sh runs them; scripts/decision-check.py refuses a second copy, a silent owner, a shape that does not build what the program reads, and prose that restates a decision as a table. See docs/decisions.md.

not_decisions.hooks/git-write-gate.sh: a fail-open allow/deny wrapper on one Bash tool call — it enforces the guard convention (#26, #280), the same class as the guarded-*.sh scripts it routes to; not a control-flow choice with a registered verdict vocabulary
not_decisions.hooks/roseline-gate.sh: a fail-open allow/deny gate on one Read tool call — every path that is not 'deny this .cs Read' exits 0 silently (docs/adr/0002), and the deny travels as a PreToolUse permissionDecision, which is not a verdict source decide.sh dispatches; the same class as hooks/git-write-gate.sh, which is modelled on it line for line (#307, #353)
not_decisions.scripts/audit-inventory.sh: a read-only structural inventory probe of a .NET repo, not a control-flow choice
not_decisions.scripts/ci-wiring-check.py: a structural completeness guard (every suite is CI-wired); it has no verdict vocabulary of its own to register
not_decisions.scripts/contrast-check.py: a WCAG contrast-ratio calculator, not a control-flow choice
not_decisions.scripts/decide.sh: the dispatcher itself — it runs decisions, it is not one
not_decisions.scripts/decision-check.py: the guard that enforces this very registry; it cannot audit itself as one of its own subjects
not_decisions.scripts/dependency-health.sh: a read-only probe of a delivered dependency graph — it runs `dotnet list package --vulnerable/--deprecated` and reports what it found, the same shape as audit-inventory.sh; phase 6's exit gate is what branches on the result
not_decisions.scripts/followups.py: aggregates follow-ups and applies the owner's stated answers to the reports; it decides nothing itself
not_decisions.scripts/main-worktree.sh: resolves a path (the main working tree's root); it answers a question, it does not branch on one
not_decisions.scripts/parse-sweep.sh: a structural guard (every suite parses under bash 3.2), not a control-flow choice with a verdict vocabulary
not_decisions.scripts/recap-wiring-check.py: a structural agreement guard (every skill links the shared recap; the hand-off table, the skills and ARCHITECTURE.md's dashed edges name the same pairs); it has no verdict vocabulary of its own to register
not_decisions.scripts/pinned-literals-check.py: a structural guard in its own declare-or-record style (the precedent R10 mirrors); not a control-flow choice
not_decisions.scripts/preflight.sh: a prerequisite probe, not a control-flow choice
not_decisions.scripts/release-title-diff.sh: lists changed paths for release-title-gate.sh; a data-extraction helper feeding a decision, not one itself
not_decisions.scripts/release-title-gate.sh: a structural gate — a title matches the required shape or it does not; no verdict vocabulary to register
not_decisions.scripts/report-dashboard.py: renders a static HTML dashboard from report.json; a report generator, not a control-flow choice
not_decisions.scripts/run-all-tests.sh: the test-suite orchestrator; it runs gates and suites in sequence, it does not itself decide anything
not_decisions.scripts/worktrees-ignored.sh: a structural guard (worktree homes are ignored), not a control-flow choice with a verdict vocabulary
not_decisions.skills/auto-dev/scripts/analyze_cache.py: an offline token-usage analysis report, not a control-flow choice
not_decisions.skills/auto-dev/scripts/decision-tally.s: a read-only tally over decide.sh's own event log (counts, ratios and two printed threshold flags); it reports on decisions already made, it does not make one of its own
not_decisions.skills/auto-dev/scripts/measure_phase2.p: an offline cost-measurement report, not a control-flow choice
not_decisions.skills/auto-dev/scripts/reconcile.sh: a deterministic GitHub ground-truth query for the supervisor loop; it reports state, the supervisor decides
not_decisions.skills/auto-dev/scripts/survey.sh: a deterministic issue-queue query; it orders and reports, the supervisor decides
not_decisions.skills/auto-dev/scripts/usage_report.py: an offline cost-accounting report, not a control-flow choice
not_decisions.skills/auto-dev/scripts/wait-ci.sh: blocks until CI is final and prints the result table; it reports state, the caller decides what to do with it
not_decisions.skills/create-issue/scripts/wire-edges.s: a guarded GitHub write helper (sub-issue and blocked_by edges, 404 = text fallback); it prints ok/fallback/FAILED per edge, the calling skill decides what a fallback means for its report
not_decisions.skills/debug-issue/find-polluter.sh: a bisection utility a developer runs by hand to find which test creates unwanted state — it reports the polluter it bisected to, the debugger decides what to do about it; not a control-flow choice the methodology makes
not_decisions.skills/debug-issue/scripts/hitl-loop.tem: a TEMPLATE a debugger copies and edits — it prompts a human and prints their answers as KEY=VALUE; it has no verdict of its own to register
not_decisions.skills/implement-issue/scripts/_assert-b: sourced by the guards, never executed on its own — a shared assertion helper, not an independent decision
not_decisions.skills/implement-issue/scripts/guarded-c: a guarded git-write wrapper; it enforces an invariant (HEAD is the named branch), not a registered verdict vocabulary
not_decisions.skills/implement-issue/scripts/guarded-m: a guarded git-write wrapper, same shape as guarded-commit.sh
not_decisions.skills/implement-issue/scripts/guarded-p: a guarded git-write wrapper, same shape as guarded-commit.sh
not_decisions.skills/implement-issue/scripts/make-work: a guarded worktree-creation wrapper; it enforces the ignore-proof precondition before creating or reusing a worktree, not a registered verdict vocabulary
not_decisions.skills/implement-issue/scripts/plan-fres: a structural freshness guard — every path the plan names either resolves against the base ref or it does not; the re-anchor that follows a MISSING is SKILL.md Step 2's judgement, not this script's, so there is no verdict vocabulary to register
not_decisions.skills/implement-issue/scripts/tick-plan: writes a checkbox-flipped plan back to GitHub, fail-closed; a mechanical write helper, not a control-flow choice
not_decisions.skills/merge-pr/scripts/base-run-verdict: resolves the base branch's check-runs for one sha and maps the registered `ci.verdict` answer onto a post-merge green/red/unverified report; it delegates every CI rule to that decision rather than restating one
not_decisions.skills/merge-pr/scripts/guarded-pr-merge: merges a PR and reads the outcome back from `gh pr view`'s state; a guarded write plus read-back, not a registered verdict vocabulary
not_decisions.skills/merge-pr/scripts/parent-decision-: reads a merged child issue's native `parent` field and appends one line to the parent's body when one exists; a mechanical read-then-conditional-edit (idempotent per PR number), not a control-flow choice
not_decisions.skills/merge-pr/scripts/remote-branch-te: finishes a remote-branch delete `gh pr merge` left undone; a mechanical cleanup step, not a control-flow choice
not_decisions.skills/profile-repo/scripts/repo-profile: detects and prints repo facts, or shows the committed profile; a probe, not a control-flow choice
not_decisions.skills/review-sessions/scripts/harvest.p: a read-only harvest over previous sessions' transcripts — it reports one record per failure signal; the review-sessions skill clusters them and decides what earns an issue
not_decisions.skills/setup-repo/scripts/parse-manifest: reads a repo-setup manifest and emits flat records; a data-shape translator, not a control-flow choice
not_decisions.skills/setup-repo/scripts/project-area-o: rewrites a copied issue form's Area dropdown from the manifest; a mechanical rewrite, not a control-flow choice
not_decisions.skills/setup-repo/scripts/repo-setup.sh: converges a repo to the expected configuration (plan/apply); it does not itself emit a registered verdict
not_decisions.skills/triage-backlog/scripts/rejected-a: a read-only keyword lookup over rejected ADRs; it reports rows and distinguishes 'found none' from 'could not look', the calling skill decides whether a hit blocks a filing
